title.es: El de cuando Cloe pregunta por México
title.en: The One Where Cloe Asks About Mexico

description.es: Cloe le pregunta a Marta si está pensando en irse a México con Pelayo. Para mantener las distancias, Marta le dice que no es asunto suyo. Cloe le responde que sí que es asunto suyo, y mucho.
description.en: Cloe asks Marta if she is considering going to Mexico with Pelayo. To keep her distance, Marta says it is none of her business. Cloe replies that it is very much her business.
